description: This file contains the implementation of the RtfWriter class responsible for generating RTF (Rich Text Format) output by writing control words, special characters, and text to a TextWriter. It provides methods for starting and ending RTF content, writing text with proper escaping, and handling control words for RTF formatting.

classes.name: RtfWriter
classes.description: Class to write RTF output, handling special characters and control words for proper RTF formatting.

methods.name: RtfWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes RtfWriter with a TextWriter instance.

methods.name: StartContent
methods.description: Starts RTF content with a left brace.

methods.name: EndContent
methods.description: Ends RTF content with a right brace.

methods.name: WriteText
methods.description: Writes text to the output, escaping special characters and handling Unicode characters.

methods.name: IsCp1252Char
methods.description: Checks if a character is available in the Windows-1252 code page.

methods.name: WriteHex
methods.description: Writes a number as a hexadecimal control word.

methods.name: WriteControl
methods.description: Writes RTF control words with optional parameters and flags.

methods.name: WriteControlWithStar
methods.description: Writes control words with a star, indicating special formatting.
